name: Blok: Parental Control
subtitle: Lock Kids' Apps & Screen Time
promotional_text: Dinner, homework, bedtime: tap LOCK on your iPhone and the apps you picked are locked on your child's iPhone. No tracking, no ads.
description:
Lock your child's apps from your own iPhone, in one tap.

Blok: Parental Control gives you a big LOCK button for your child's iPhone. Tap it and the apps you picked, like games and social media, are locked right away. Tap again to unlock, or let a timer do it for you.

ONE TAP, FROM YOUR PHONE
• Lock until you unlock, or for 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours
• Schedules for school hours and bedtime that lock and unlock on their own
• See when your child's phone has confirmed the lock

YOU CHOOSE WHAT'S LOCKED
• Lock games, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat or any app you pick
• Phone and Messages can stay open; emergency calls always work
• Up to three children, each locked on their own

BUILT ON APPLE'S SCREEN TIME
• iOS enforces the lock, so it holds when the app is closed or the phone restarts
• A parent PIN protects the settings on your child's phone

A LOCK, NOT A SPY
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Blok never reads messages, tracks location or collects what your child does
• Your child needs no account; data is stored in the EU
• Delete your account in the app and everything is gone

HOW IT WORKS
1. Install Blok on your iPhone and your child's iPhone (iOS 16 or later)
2. Pair them with a code and pick the apps to lock
3. Tap LOCK, wherever you are

Blok Plus is a subscription; the price for your country is shown in the App Store. Unlocking always works, even without a subscription.
